[Sharper volume bounds at a scalar minimum (Remark 27.44)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0046 1. ch27:27.44\group Volume growth

If $O$ minimizes both $R$ and $f$, then $\operatorname {Vol}B_O(r)\le \omega _nr^n$.
